name: Pilzbrut von Moosgrab
mini: Drei Pilzwesen von Chris (17.10.): Konsolenpilz-Kopf mit gelöcherter Armplatte, brauner Pilzhut-Kopf, Fliegenpilz-Träger mit roten Hüten (Anführer). Ein Trupp, gleiche Werte.

karte.name: Pilzbrut von Moosgrab
karte.bossText: Nur das Modell mit den roten Pilzen hat Rauschsporen. Stirbt es, enden sie.
karte.flavor: Kleine Körper kriechen aus dem Moos. Pilzbewachsen. Zuckend. Hungrig.
karte.look: a pack of three fungal creatures, one with red fly agaric caps leading

prompt:
Create one image in portrait format 4:5 (if 4:5 is not available, use 2:3).

Style: a dramatic still frame from a big-budget live-action dark fantasy horror film, the kind of shot that ends up on the poster. Photorealistic and cinematic: anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, strong directional light with deep shadows, volumetric haze, fine film grain, a muted, slightly desaturated colour grade.

This is a real scene, not a model: the three creatures are full-size living beings, made with practical creature effects (prosthetics, real wet fungal tissue, slime, dirt), with matte organic surfaces and no plastic sheen. Never miniatures, figurines, toys or painted models.

Reference: the attached photos show my three hand-painted tabletop miniatures. Recreate these exact three creatures: same body shapes, same colours, same mushrooms. Change only the materials (real wet fungal tissue instead of plastic and paint) and give them life-size scale. Do not invent different creatures. Do not show the bases, the table or the room from the photos.

Subject: three fungal creatures that were once people, the Pilzbrut of Moosgrab. Their bodies are pale ochre-yellow ridged fungal tissue with brown rot, long thin limbs and clawed hands. One is tall and gangly with a head of layered brown bracket fungi and a porous yellow plate on one arm. One has a wide brown mushroom cap as a head and clusters of small brown mushrooms on its shoulder. The leader is hunched and covered in red fly agaric caps with white spots, clearly the most dangerous of the three.

The moment: night in a dense, wet forest. A traveller's lantern has just fallen into the moss in the foreground and lies on its side. The red-capped leader lunges out of the dark towards the camera, claws raised, mouth gaping; the other two crawl out of the undergrowth behind it, twitching. The victim is never shown, only implied.

Camera and light: very low camera at ground level next to the fallen lantern, slightly wide (35mm), the creatures looming over the viewer. The lantern lights them from below with warm flickering light; cold blue moonlight falls through the trees from behind and outlines their silhouettes.

Glowing accent: exactly one, a faint sickly yellow-green cloud of spores bursting from the red caps of the leader. Apart from the lantern's natural flame, nothing else in the image glows.

Background: dark and out of focus: moss, roots, wet bark, mist, a few small pale mushrooms. No buildings, towers, moons, ships, floating objects or other creatures.

Composition: portrait 4:5. The three creatures grouped in the centre and filling most of the frame, the red-capped leader in front and largest, the other two just behind it to the left and right, heads in the upper half. Keep a little dark, calm space near the top right corner, because the card's points badge sits there.

Not wanted: landscape format, miniature, figurine, toy, tabletop diorama, macro or tilt-shift photography, plastic or painted-model look, creatures simply standing still in a landscape. Also no digital painting, illustration, concept art, trading-card art, visible brush strokes, over-sharpened detail, oversaturated colours, fire or light effects all over the frame. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, card frame, border or user interface.
